base_contract.rule: all V1.4 semantics carried verbatim except the two repairs registered below

UNC_A1_contradictory_limitation.defect: V1.4 derivation_tables.EXPLICIT_LIMITATION.CONTRADICTORY_LIMITATION = PARTIAL conflicts with UNRESOLVED semantics for unusable limitation prose; caused 0.75 human instability in V2.7D
UNC_A1_contradictory_limitation.repair: EXPLICIT_LIMITATION x CONTRADICTORY_LIMITATION => UNRESOLVED (PARTIAL row removed)

UNC_A2_unclear_prose.defect: UNCLEAR_PROSE behavior not defined in V1.4 output_behaviors
UNC_A2_unclear_prose.repair: UNCLEAR_PROSE added as output behavior; canonical verdict UNRESOLVED in all derivation tables

uncertainty_model.applicability_rule: NONE => NOT_REQUIRED (requirement_applicable NO); EXPLICIT_LIMITATION, NON_ASSERTION_CONSTRAINT, COMPOUND => applicable YES; NON_ASSERTION_CONSTRAINT + NOT_REQUIRED is schema-invalid
uncertainty_model.non_assertion_constraint_definition: criterion requires that a specific overconclusion is NOT asserted/implied; no explicit hedge required; applicability YES

behavior_definitions.CONTRADICTORY_LIMITATION: limitation prose that contradicts itself or retracts itself at sentence level; does not communicate a usable epistemic limitation
behavior_definitions.UNCLEAR_PROSE: limitation-related output text cannot be classified as communicating a limitation, failing to communicate one, or making a specific prohibited over-conclusion, because the text is incoherent or fragmentary at sentence level

uncertainty_model.compound_rule: mode COMPOUND requires explicit component list (kind EXPRESSION|NON_ASSERTION + behavior); verdict derived per component with the repaired tables then aggregated: all SATISFIED => SATISFIED; VIOLATED+SATISFIED => PARTIAL; all VIOLATED => VIOLATED; no VIOLATED with some SATISFIED => PARTIAL; else UNRESOLVED
uncertainty_model.absence_vs_violation: absence of uncertainty language is never automatically VIOLATED; VIOLATION requires the output to assert or imply a claim conflicting with the requirement; NON_ASSERTION + absence of prohibited conclusion = SATISFIED
uncertainty_model.partial_vs_unresolved: PARTIAL = identifiable part of requirement fulfilled; UNRESOLVED = cannot safely determine fulfilment or violation from text, including contradictory, self-retracted, or incoherent limitation prose; PARTIAL is never 'mild uncertainty'

carried_semantics_from_v1_2: verbatim from V1.4 contract; route and forbidden semantics untouched
freeze_rule: contract may be amended only before Set B labeling starts; after Set B starts it is frozen for the task
